messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "medication prescribed by your doctor for psychotic disorders"
set: ["medication prescribed by your doctor for psychotic disorders", "take as prescribed by your doctor", "use exactly as prescribed by your doctor", "avoid medication errors by using prescribed medicine", "dose prescribed by your doctor may be used", "take only the amount prescribed by your doctor", "only use as prescribed by your physician", "psychotic symptoms", "keep using all other medications as prescribed by your doctor", "use only the brand and form prescribed by your doctor", "tell doctor about drugs prescribed by other doctors", "take extra vitamin B12 as prescribed by doctor", "avoid medication errors by using only the medicine your doctor prescribes", "never take for longer than recommended by your doctor", "ask your doctor before changing your medication dosage", "use as directed by your doctor"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "take as prescribed by your doctor",
    "use exactly as prescribed by your doctor",
    "dose prescribed by your doctor may be used",
    "take only the amount prescribed by your doctor",
    "only use as prescribed by your physician",
    "keep using all other medications as prescribed by your doctor",
    "use only the brand and form prescribed by your doctor",
    "tell doctor about drugs prescribed by other doctors",
    "take extra vitamin B12 as prescribed by doctor",
    "avoid medication errors by using only the medicine your doctor prescribes",
    "ask your doctor before changing your medication dosage",
    "use as directed by your doctor"
  ],
  "alias": "use as directed by your doctor"
}
